blacklistabilityReview.evidence: FinChain Dollar resolves to Yes because metadata classifies the asset as a centralized, licensed issuer stablecoin and the token is issued through issuer-managed deployments.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: FUSD has four independently stateful, issuer-native deployments on Ethereum, Avalanche, Sonic, and Monad. Chainlink CCIP BurnMintTokenPools and TokenBridgeSender provide additional cross-chain burn/mint and transfer machinery; their route-scoped controls remain separate from native Mint Authority. The external CCIP messaging and pool validation path, plus shared FinChain EOA and ProxyAdmin failure domains, keep the overall bridge tier at external-validated-network.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: OpenAI Codex C09 mint-bridge boundary migration

controls.label: FUSD TokenBridgeSender cross-chain transfer proxy

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The current TokenBridgeSender implementation transfers or burns already supplied FUSD through supported custom or CCIP destinations; it is bridge transfer machinery rather than an independent native issuance path.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The proxy remains a token MINTER_ROLE holder, but the verified implementation contains no FUSD.mint call. The shared zero-delay ProxyAdmin can replace it with mint-capable bridge logic; that upgrade-mediated contingency remains in Mint Authority upgradeability.

controls.capDescription: Current sender logic has no FUSD mint call; the nominal token MINTER_ROLE becomes mint-relevant only if the shared ProxyAdmin replaces the implementation.
controls.evidence: At the current proxy reads on Ethereum block 25770580, Avalanche block 92979277, Sonic block 77632253, and Monad block 96607753, the same-address TokenBridgeSender proxy was a token MINTER_ROLE member on every local FUSD token. Its verified implementation only transfers or burns supplied bridge tokens and never calls FUSD.mint. The nominal mint role therefore remains bridge-route evidence with an upgrade-mediated contingency, while current native mint authority stays in the gateway and token-admin controls.

controls.label: FUSD Ethereum CCIP BurnMintTokenPool Chainlink-owned

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: This BurnMintTokenPool is supply-conserving CCIP burn/mint route machinery, not independent issuer-native mint authority.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At the observed block the pool's releaseOrMint path validates the Chainlink router, configured remote pool/token, RMN state, allowlist, and inbound message route; remote pool/token inventory for every selector was not fully decoded in this review.
routeChecks.rateLimits: At Ethereum block 25770565, getRateLimitAdmin() returned the zero address. The pool enforces inbound and outbound rate limits, and its owner contract 0x914d7fec6aac8cd542e72bca78b30650d45643d7 is the administrator capable of route-limit changes; its signer/control threshold was not resolved.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The pool owner is the Chainlink contract 0x914d7fec6aac8cd542e72bca78b30650d45643d7. No Safe threshold or signer identity is inferred for that contract.
